final: WITH genre_averages AS (SELECT GenreId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Track GROUP BY GenreId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM genre_averages) SELECT AVG(g.avg_price), AVG(g.avg_ratio), AVG(g.avg_ratio - o.avg_ratio) FROM genre_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > o.avg_ratio
